renderer: UE 5.8.2 Win64 Development packaged game, DX12, offscreen
capture: runtime_visual_performance.py: three warmed 20 second samples with live team AI
metric: FPS from frame counter deltas; frameMs is sampled game delta at roughly 22Hz; not a complete frame trace
notes: Numbers are bounded local measurements, not an uncapped GPU benchmark.
limitation: Initial packaged pond sample caught one 194.8ms frame; 45-second continuous follow-up averaged 59.94 FPS with zero sampled frames over 50ms. Occasional hitches are not ruled out.
